runtime_behavior.validated_save: rejects invalid item or corpse state before filesystem mutation
runtime_behavior.atomic_replace: writes and re-deserializes a temporary file before replacing authoritative state
runtime_behavior.validated_load: rejects corrupt JSON and structurally invalid runtime ownership state
runtime_behavior.stale_temp: removed before load or save; never promoted automatically

classic_activation: No native save-layout meaning is inferred. This policy protects Reforged persistence until native formats are exhausted.
safe_fallback: fail without replacing the last authoritative save
